title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - Light
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/Light. A light source, which may be a lantern, a street light, a floodlight, a signal lamp or any other device whose primary purpose is the generation of light (definition taken from OpenStreetMap wiki, Proposed_features/Key:light_source). Top-level saref:FeatureKind in the Lighting Domain (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.1.2); s4envi:FlashingLight is a narrower kind of Light (skos:broader) but not modelled as its own entity here (it is a named individual used as a classification value, not an independently-defined class).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Light'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geolocation of the light, expressed as a GeoJSON Point. Enrichment (ontology does not formally assert geo:Feature for Light, but it is a physical light source).

color.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/Color'. Color of the emitted light. It might be indicated by named colors or using other type of color values like hexadecimal for RGB, color temperature, etc. Flattened from saref:hasProperty :Color (an individual of s4envi:LightProperty; LightProperty is not modelled as its own entity -- see standard-metadata.yaml).

geometry.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/Geometry'. The shape of a light emission. It may be described by individuals like 'spherical', 'cylindrical', etc. even though it is open to more complex representation of geometries using other vocabularies. Flattened from saref:hasProperty :Geometry.

lightProjectionHeight.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/LightProjectionHeight'. The height from which a light is projected. Unit of measure: metre (m); not fixed by the ontology. Flattened from saref:hasProperty :LightProjectionHeight (broader property: Height).

lightProjectionDirection.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/LightProjectionDirection'. The direction in which a light is projected. Represented as a compass bearing in degrees [0, 360); not fixed by the ontology. Flattened from saref:hasProperty :LightProjectionDirection.
